newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel bank workers threaten full strike.
newsitem.headline: Israel bank workers threaten full strike.

text.p: Israel's 35,000 bank workers plan to start an indefinite strike on Tuesday to press for a five-day work week, an official of the Histadrut Trade Unions Federation said on Sunday.

"This matter has been dragging on for the last nine years. The bank workers' labour committees are fed up and decided, without Histadrut authorisation, to go on strike," said the official, Zion Shema.
Workers at Israel's major banks, demanding a five-day work week, have been striking for the past three Fridays.

Bank officials have said an agreement to coordinate a move to a five-day week was rejected by anti-trust authorities, who ruled banks could not make a collective decision to close on the same day -- Friday.
Israeli banks operate Sunday through Thursday and for a half day on Friday. During strikes on the last three Fridays, only banks at border crossings have remained open.
Shema said the Histadrut was trying to arrange contacts between bank workers and management to avert a full-scale strike.
